title: 耐克在市值蒸发2000亿美元后退出标普100指数，结束18年成分股历史
summary: 据《财富》报道，耐克（Nike）在经历约2000亿美元市值大幅缩水后，被剔除出标普100指数，结束了其长达18年的成分股地位。该消息在Hacker News上引发广泛讨论，获得246点热度与319条评论。文章指出，耐克股价持续下跌是此次被剔除的直接原因，反映出这家运动服饰巨头近年来在市场竞争、消费趋势变化及品牌战略调整等方面面临的严峻挑战。标普100指数由美国市值最大的100家公司组成，成分股变动通常被视为企业市场地位与投资者信心的重要风向标。耐克此次退出不仅意味着其市值排名下滑，也可能影响被动型指数基金的持仓配置，进一步对股价形成压力。事件引发业界对传统零售品牌在快速变化的消费环境中如何维持竞争力的思考。
summary_en: According to Fortune, Nike has been removed from the S&P 100 index after roughly $200 billion in market-cap losses, ending 18 years as a constituent. The news drew significant discussion on Hacker News, with 246 points and 319 comments. The article attributes the removal to a sustained decline in Nike's stock price, reflecting serious challenges the sportswear giant faces in market competition, shifting consumer trends, and brand strategy adjustments. The S&P 100 comprises the largest U.S. companies by market capitalization, and constituent changes are typically seen as a key barometer of corporate standing and investor confidence. Nike's exit signals a drop in market-cap ranking and could pressure its stock further through passive index fund rebalancing. The event prompts broader reflection on how traditional retail brands can stay competitive in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape.
